en.headline: Ex-Cathay Pacific officer jailed 20 months for bribes in human smuggling case
en.dek: Tsui Ying-kit, 45, pleaded guilty to accepting at least HK$18,000 to help ineligible travellers check in at the airport between 2008 and 2009 after years on the run.
body: A former Cathay Pacific customer services officer was sentenced to 20 months' imprisonment at Tsuen Wan Court on Wednesday after pleading guilty to four counts of conspiracy for an agent to accept advantages.

Tsui Ying-kit, 45, admitted accepting at least HK$18,000 in bribes from two human smuggling syndicates between September 2008 and August 2009. He used the airline's computer system to check flight and security information so that ineligible mainland travellers could complete check-in and pass security at Hong Kong International Airport. He also offered up to HK$2,000 to two colleagues each time they assisted.

Tsui had jumped bail in October 2009 and remained at large until he returned from the mainland and surrendered in July last year. The court heard the offences involved escorts accompanying the travellers.

zh.headline: 前國泰地勤涉收賄助偷渡判囚20個月
zh.dek: 45歲徐英傑承認於2008至2009年收取至少1.8萬元利益，協助不合資格旅客辦理登機手續，潛逃多年後自首。
body: 一名前國泰航空客戶服務主任星期三在荃灣法院承認四項代理人串謀接受利益罪，被判監禁20個月。
45歲徐英傑承認於2008年9月至2009年8月期間，從兩個偷渡集團收取至少1.8萬元賄賂。他利用航空公司電腦系統查閱航班及保安資料，確保不合資格的內地旅客能完成辦理登機手續並通過機場安檢。他亦曾每次向兩名同事提供最多2,000元，要求他們協助。
徐英傑於2009年10月棄保潛逃，直至去年7月從內地返港自首。案件涉及陪同旅客的帶路人。
